Package io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.processor.paper

Record Class PaperExecutionSource

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.processor.paper.PaperExecutionSource
Record Components:
processor - the owning Paper generator
nodes - the Brigadier nodes in argument order
parsedNodeCount - the number of nodes already parsed
public record PaperExecutionSource(PaperCommandGenerator processor, List<io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.processor.paper.PaperCommandGenerator.NodeInfo> nodes, int parsedNodeCount) extends Record
Emits the execution body of one Brigadier node chain: sender resolution, parameter retrieval from the Brigadier context, and the call into the command instance.
